title: Creepy Not, Zombie Flamingos don't "Pop!"
text: Creepy Not, Zombie Flamingos don't "Pop!". I ordered 2 of these, one is for a friend.  I remembered reading on the other reviews about the wire legs but wanted to get them anyway because I thought I could get something to make them a little less rickety looking.  The zombie flamingo is a funky idea, but the actual item wasn't quite what I had expected.  It's not as detailed as it appeared in the photo. I may go over it with my own paints to brighten it up a bit. They have hope though, with a little added work on my end, I think they'll make a statement. The packaging and shipping were just right.

product_metadata.title: Forum Novelties unisex adults Zombie Flamingo Party Supplies, Multi, Standard US
features: The red, white, black and silver plastic Zombie Flamingo includes metal legs
Item Dimensions: 24 "High x 9" Long x 6" Deep
description: Regular people decorate with pink flamingos - when you are a zombie it just makes sense to decorate with a flock of Zombie flamingos. The scary-looking Zombie Flamingo decoration has blood-red eyes, an exposed skull and metal legs so you can perch it indoors or out.
